title: TRUWILD

title: Mushroom Revival

title: BIOHM Health
q: biohm health ~$5-6m gut-health brand, founder + scientist led. the live nourish regimen page links its probiotic to a 404, the flagship probiotic pdp stacks four overlapping discounts at once, and the pages are shogun builds full of pasted ms-word markup. founders afif ghannoum (ceo) and dr. mahmoud ghannoum (renowned mycobiome scientist, case western) are credible and reachable. supplements biohmhealth.com broken internal product link: the live nourish regimen page links its probiotic to /products/biohm-probiotic-supplement, which 404s (the live handle is /products/probiotic-supplement) on-site product copy routes buyers to a 404 instead of the flagship product. discount-stacking on the flagship pdp: a sale price, subscribe & save 15%, a 40%-off code (totalpro40), and a save-about-30% claim all shown at once overlapping discounts erode margin and muddy the offer at the decision point. product pages are built in shogun with content pasted from ms word (scxw/textrun span artifacts in the html), producing bloated, hard-to-maintain markup bloat hurts maintainability and likely page speed (confirm with pagespeed). customer reviews/ratings are not surfaced at the buy box on the flagship probiotic (it leans on a clinical study and a 2023 award; no visible star rating or review count) no customer social proof at the decision point on a $35 supplement. afif ghannoum co-founder & ceo solid [{"h":"why this is a good lead","blocks":[{"p":"biohm health (cleveland, oh) sells clinically studied probiotics, prebiotics and gut-health products dtc on shopify, plus an at-home gut test. revenue is estimated around $5-6m with roughly 20-29 staff and venture backing.","why":"revenue clears six-figures/mo, the founders are credible and reachable, and the site has concrete, fixable issues (a dead link to the flagship from live copy, a confusing 4-way discount stack, bloated page-builder markup)."}]}]

title: Clean Simple Eats
q: clean simple eats ~$21.6m/yr protein & nutrition brand, bootstrapped and founder-led. functional but dated theme with a clear money leak: bestseller flavors are sold out and the back-in-stock capture looks paused, so proven demand bounces with no waitlist. strong revenue and reachable founders (erika & jj peterson); the highest-leverage fix is demand capture on sold-out hero skus. supplements cleansimpleeats.com bestseller flavors are sold out (the pdp shows this flavor sold out fast) and back-in-stock capture appears paused (products.json shows bis-paused tags) proven demand on hero skus bounces with no waitlist/email capture, losing both sales and first-party data on a high-revenue consumable. subscribe-and-save is not surfaced at the buy box on the consumable pdp (subscription exists per products.json tags but is not prominent above the fold) under-monetizes recurring revenue on daily-use products; subscription is the main ltv lever for supplements. heavy distressed/grunge display type across headers reduces legibility and scannability, especially on mobile readability friction on the primary conversion path. logo lockup renders the eats wordmark inside a black block that reads as an unpolished/placeholder treatment minor first-impression/brand-polish issue at the top of every page. erika peterson co-founder solid [{"h":"why this is a good lead","blocks":[{"p":"clean simple eats sells protein powders, hydration and wellness products dtc plus retail and a branded cse+ app. bootstrapped from personal debt to an estimated eight figures, founded ~2014.","why":"revenue clears six figures/mo comfortably, the founders are public and reachable, and there is a concrete, fixable win (capture demand on sold-out bestsellers) rather than only cosmetic theme gripes."}]}]
